original_question: Write a Verilog module named `clock_generator` with a single input `clk_in` and a single output `clk_out`. Assume the input clock `clk_in` has a frequency of 50 MHz. Your module should generate an output clock `clk_out` with a frequency of 5 Hz and approximately a 50% duty cycle. Define the module with inputs `clk_in` and output `clk_out`.
